title: solidago rugosa var. aspera
intro: Solidago rugosa var. aspera, commonly known as rough-leaved goldenrod, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family and is native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating wounds, infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Solidago rugosa var. aspera include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
